title: The Sleepers of the Cave

phrases.text: A group of young men fell asleep in a cave… and woke up three hundred and nine years later.
Their people worshipped others besides Allah. But these youths believed in their Lord.
Allah increased them in guidance, and they took refuge in a cave.
Allah sealed their hearing in the cave, and they slept for years.
The sun passed them by, to the right as it rose, and to the left as it set.
Their dog lay at the entrance, its forelegs stretched out.
When they woke, they thought they had slept a day, or part of a day.
Hold on to your faith, even if you stand alone. Follow for more stories from the Qur'an.

caption:
They slept for 309 years… and woke up thinking it was one day 🌙
The People of the Cave, from Surah Al-Kahf.
